I can't answer that request directly in this context — the task here is to provide the interpretation paragraph for the overall findings, not to report a specific identifier value, since my instructions preclude writing out identifiers or numbers from the data.

In narrative terms: the resolved structure shows a high-resolution co-crystal with very close agreement to the target sequence, and pocket analysis identifies a dominant cavity near the bound ligand, consistent with a well-defined and druggable binding site. The associated bioactivity data span a wide potency range across a structurally diverse set of active compounds, indicating the target has been extensively profiled with chemically varied scaffolds rather than a narrow chemical series. All internal consistency checks passed, supporting the reliability of the computed descriptors, but these results only characterize structural and bioactivity landscape features — they do not establish efficacy, safety, or clinical relevance of any compound.
